sheet:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create a wide 16:9 three-panel photographic character reference sheet for the single fictional adult character Claire, produced for a Korean filmmaking guide. Image 1 is the authoritative identity and wardrobe reference: preserve the almond-shaped eyes and lid line, facial proportions, natural skin texture, chin, nose and lips, near-black straight hair with bangs and low ponytail, small gold hoops and slate blue-gray soft cotton button-front shirt. Image 2 is supplemental only for the low ponytail, shirt, and body silhouette of the black-haired woman on the LEFT. Disregard the other person, scene, objects, pose and lighting in image 2.

Exactly three equal-width adjacent panels in one horizontal row with boundaries at exactly one-third and two-thirds of the canvas width. Use the same matte neutral mid-gray studio backdrop, soft even white light, balanced exposure with natural texture, no props and no readable text or graphics. LEFT panel: photo of head and shoulders facing directly forward at eye level, both eyes visible with calm neutral expression, shoulders down, no beauty retouch, the same face as image 1. Include crown and a little space around hair. CENTER panel: full body front view, neutral symmetric upright stance with both arms loose at sides, fingers relaxed and legs straight, both feet flat, entire head and shoes visible with margin. RIGHT panel: full body rear view of literally the same person rotated 180 degrees, same stance, body proportions, size, shoulder height and floor level as center panel; low ponytail and back of the same shirt clearly visible. Full-body costume: that slate blue-gray long sleeve shirt untucked, straight charcoal work trousers, low matte black lace-up shoes, both views identical. Make the two standing figures head-to-toe with the same scale and matching horizontal head and floor lines. Use soft subtle contact shadows, realistic seams, no monochrome stylization. Preserve the clean gray gap between the panels, with subjects fully inside their own panel. No words, numbers, borders, logo or watermark. Do not blur or mask any face in this sheet.
mask: Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the edit target. Reproduce this exact 1672 by 941 three-panel photo sheet at the same 16:9 composition, applying exactly one tiny local edit. The center panel is the front full-body photo. Paint a small opaque matte neutral-gray shape matched to the backdrop over only the eyes, brows, nose and lips of the SMALL FACE IN THE CENTER PANEL, making those face features completely unreadable. Keep the front full-body hair with bangs, ears, gold hoops, head silhouette, outer jaw, neck and collar visible. Do not apply anything to the large close-up on the left. Preserve every detail outside that small center face area as faithfully as possible: keep the exact left portrait and rear view, figure sizes, gray backdrop, feet, outfits, color and lighting, and both panel boundaries. No text.
